preconditions.description: The number of test cases T must be between 1 and 100,000.
The number of cities N in each test case must be between 1 and 100,000.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= A[i] <= 10**9 for i in range(N))
preconditions.description: Each city's significance A[i] must be between 0 and 1,000,000,000.
The total number of cities across all test cases must not exceed 300,000.

postconditions.expression: stdout == '-1' if not any((A[i] & A[j] & L) == L for i in range(N) for j in range(i + 1, N) for L in range(1, max(A) + 1)) else True
postconditions.description: If it is impossible to connect all cities, output -1.
Output the minimum total length of roads required to connect all cities.
